thread:
jess_support: FYI we have a customer on a Dedicated plan reporting their token cost dashboard shows $0 or NaN for several days. Org: org_7421C. Customer called this morning. Screenshot attached: https://redwood.s3/priv/7421C-cost-issue.png

maria_support: Got it — they said billing page looks normal but token-cost graph and table show 0 or NaN when filtering 03/01-03/10. They're worried we're not charging.

jess_support: Can someone from analytics confirm if ingestion or aggregation pipelined failed for that org? Any recent deploys to metrics?

tim_analytics: Looking now. Quick check: our hourly aggregation job ran for most orgs but I see multiple ERRORs around 03/04 02:xx UTC in metrics-agg-worker logs. Pasting small repro: 
```
SELECT org_id, sum(token_cost) as cost_total FROM token_events
WHERE org_id='org_7421C' AND event_ts BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-03-10'
GROUP BY org_id;
-- returns: cost_total: NaN
```

raj_eng: @tim_analytics can you share the raw events count for that org in event storage? Is it missing or malformed?

tim_analytics: Raw events exist. event_count ~ 125k for period. But token_cost field is null on a subset ~ 18% of records due to recent schema rename from token_cost_usd to token_cost. Our aggregation assumes token_cost exists.

raj_eng: Ugh. That schema rename was in the decode lambda last week for x-llm-instrumentation v2. We added a compatibility alias but looks like a race: some producers still emit old key. Should have fallen back.

infra-bot: deploy:decode-lambda v2.1.4 -> success (2026-03-03T23:47:12Z)

maria_support: Customer asked for ETA on fix — they want to know if they'll get billed correctly and if dashboard will reflect historical costs.

raj_eng: Immediate fix: update aggregation to coalesce(token_cost, token_cost_usd) and re-run hourly agg for affected window. I can push a hotfix to metrics-agg within 30 min. Then we'll trigger a backfill job to recompute those days.

tim_analytics: Confirmed: coalesce fixes query locally. Example after change: 
```
SELECT org_id, sum(COALESCE(token_cost, token_cost_usd, 0.0)) as cost_total FROM token_events ...
-- returns: cost_total: 1832.45
```

jess_support: Please also include a script to mark the dashboard as 'stale' while backfill runs so customers see a banner. Product OK with that? @emily_pm

emily_pm: Yes, banner is fine. Also, let's send a short status update to the customer. Don't promise billing changes until finance confirms.

raj_eng: Hotfix deployed to metrics-agg-prod (2026-03-04T10:12Z). Kicking off backfill for org_7421C and other orgs with nulls. Backfill estimated 18 minutes for single org.

tim_analytics: Backfill started. I'll post logs here.

infra-bot: job:metrics-backfill org_7421C window=2026-03-01..2026-03-10 status=running (triggered by raj_eng)

tim_analytics: Backfill done. Aggregates recomputed. Dashboard now shows cost for that org; values match raw events. I ran quick check for 5 more orgs that had NaN earlier — all fixed.

jess_support: Great. Maria, can you update the customer that dashboard corrected and we're validating billing? Also note the temporary banner during re-compute.

maria_support: Will do. Sending message now.

emily_pm: Action items: (1) add compatibility tests to ingestion to catch renamed keys; (2) add a small-metric alert if >5% token_events have null token_cost for an org over 6h; (3) run a cluster scan to find other orgs impacted. I'll open tickets.

raj_eng: Added ticket ENG-9123 for hotfix follow-up and ENG-9124 for compat tests.

jess_support: Closing loop: customer acknowledged update and is OK for now. Thanks all.

maria_support: Customer message: "Thanks — dashboard shows values now. Please confirm if any invoice changes will follow." Finance looped in.

tim_analytics: FYI: root cause summary — schema rename in decode lambda without robust fallback caused 18% of records to have null token_cost; aggregation assumed non-null leading to NaN or 0 display. Resolved by coalesce in agg + backfill.

jess_support: Marking thread resolved but keep monitoring dashboards for 24h. If anything else pops up ping here. :thumbsup:
